name: Plane
summary: Plane is an open-core project and issue tracker with states, five priority levels, bulk assignment and a GitHub integration that moves work items when pull requests change. The Free plan allows up to 12 users, and Pro costs $8 per user per month or $6 on annual billing.

facts.text: Priority has five options, Urgent, High, Medium, Low and None, and new work items start at None.
New work items start in the project's default state, and Plane records a completed date when an item moves into a Completed state.
Referencing a work item ID in brackets, such as [WEB-344], in a pull request title or description links it and enables automatic state changes.
GitHub issues and Plane work items can sync title, description, state, assignees, labels and comments, in one direction or both.
SSO with SAML or OIDC is listed for the Business plan on cloud and self-hosted, and for Pro on self-hosted only. The Free plan has no integrations listed.
